record.notes: Dated March 2026; approved by Cabinet on 25 March 2026 (combined with a special sitting of Cabinet on 1 April 2026), signed by the Minister on 9 April 2026 and gazetted on 10 April 2026 for 60 days of public comment, to 10 June 2026. It was based on the South Africa National Artificial Intelligence Policy Framework of August 2024 (ZA-02), the 32 submissions received on it and consultations through the Cabinet cluster process, and set out staged implementation: draft requirements for unacceptable risks in year 1 (2025/26), requirements for high-risk use cases in year 2 (2026/27) and full implementation in year 3 (2027/28). It was withdrawn in its entirety by Notice 3978 of 2026 (Government Gazette No. 54840), signed on 4 June 2026 and gazetted on 12 June 2026, with no reason given.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Stored: the gazetted draft (General Notice 3880 of 2026, Government Gazette No. 54477, 86 pages) and the gov.za notice page 'Withdrawal of draft South Africa National Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy' (both gov.za, 11 Oct 2026), and the withdrawal notice itself (Notice 3978 of 2026, Government Gazette No. 54840, one page, gov.za, 18 Oct 2026). The gazette confirms the title, the issuing minister and department, Cabinet approval, the publication date, the comment period, the basis in the 2024 framework and the content summarised. The withdrawal notice confirms that the Minister withdrew Government Notice 3880 in its entirety, effective from publication in the gazette of 12 June 2026, and that he signed it on 4 June 2026; it gives no reason. No replacement draft is among the stored files.

judgment.status_reasoning: Gazetted as a draft for public comment on 10 April 2026 (General Notice 3880, GG 54477). Notice 3978 of 2026 (GG 54840, 12 June 2026), signed by the Minister on 4 June 2026, withdraws Government Notice 3880 and states that the draft 'is withdrawn in its entirety effective from the date of publication'. Revoked / withdrawn since 12 June 2026, with legal force Proposed, as for any unadopted draft.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A Cabinet-approved draft national AI policy with a risk-based regime, a National AI Safety Institute, an AI Regulatory Authority and liability and redress mechanisms; in scope with no note, kept for context after its withdrawal.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2026-04-10 is the gazette date of Notice 3880; the Minister signed on 9 April 2026 and Cabinet approved on 25 March 2026, both in the notes. date_last_updated 2026-06-12 is the gazette date of the withdrawal notice (STAATSKOERANT, 12 Junie 2026, No. 54840), from which the withdrawal took effect; the signing date of 4 June 2026 goes in the notes.
judgment.topics_reasoning: risk-based classification (systems categorised by levels of potential harm), safety institute (National AI Safety Institute), evaluation & testing (mandatory testing of high-stakes systems, algorithmic audits and bias testing), accountability & liability (AI Regulatory Authority, Ombudsperson, Insurance Superfund), deepfakes & synthetic media (remedies for deepfakes), transparency & labelling (explainable AI required for high-risk use cases).
